name: Mouth tape

lead: Mouth taping means placing a strip of gentle tape over the lips at night to keep the mouth closed and encourage nasal breathing. It spread through social media with claims of better sleep, less snoring, fresher breath and a better jawline.
In looksmaxxing circles it is tied to the idea that nasal breathing shapes adult facial structure, a claim for which no supporting evidence has been published.

paras: Sealing the lips forces air through the nose, which filters and humidifies it and may reduce dry mouth. Any effect on jaw shape has not been established, because adult facial bone does not meaningfully remodel with breathing route.

Systematic and scoping reviews find only small, preliminary studies, with one small trial in mouth-breathers with mild sleep apnea suggesting possible benefit, and conclude that demonstrated benefit is minimal. The main concerns are taping over nasal obstruction or undiagnosed sleep apnea, skin irritation and suffocation anxiety. Clinicians advise that people with snoring, daytime sleepiness or blocked nasal airways be evaluated before trying it.
